Join over 10 million users! Become a better sleeper and morning person thanks to 100 years of sleep science with RISE, the only sleep tracker that also measures your sleep debt and energy levels.

Recommended by the Sleep Foundation and trusted by teams in the NFL, MLB, and NBA, and top Fortune 500 companies, RISE makes it easy to improve your sleep and energy.

But RISE is more than a sleep and energy tracker. Users can access widgets, calendar integration, sleeping sounds, meditation guides, smart alarm clocks, habit reminders, and a sleep knowledge library.

FROM THE RISE COMMUNITY

***
Chase M.
"RISE helped me understand how vital sleep truly is. In only a few weeks, I found myself more focused, energetic, and productive at work."

***
Becky G.
"I could see where sleep debt was causing issues, like temper short, not comprehending things, moving slowly.  I had an epiphany... I'm getting 45min more sleep on average than I was before RISE."


UNLOCK BETTER SLEEP
Tired of the age-old "eight hours of shut-eye" advice? Go beyond buying a new mattress or pillow and discover the life-changing concept of Sleep Debt.

Scientifically proven to be a vital factor in your well-being, a low Sleep Debt can improve your life quality and even your longevity—while high Sleep Debt can cause fatigue and harm your health.

RISE calculates your Sleep Debt, helps you understand its impact on your energy, and guides you on how to lower it by improving sleeping habits. Learn about your melatonin window, when to prioritize sleep, and understand the real cost of those late nights—and how you can benefit from naps.

PERSONALIZED SLEEP TRACKER
Do you find your mind racing when your head hits the pillow? Can’t stop doom-scrolling on your phone? Feeling fatigued all day?

Based on your sleep data, circadian rhythm and research, we’ll make recommendations that fit your needs and guide you toward healthier habits.

RISE will get you in bed on time, guide you when you can’t sleep, reduce the times you wake up at night, and make you feel less groggy in the morning.

DISCOVER YOUR CIRCADIAN RHYTHM
We all have an internal brain clock, our circadian rhythm, it signals to our body when to be alert or go into recovery mode. Everyone is unique, from when we perform our best to when we should sleep and wake up. We use advanced algorithms to find your optimal sleep windows.

You’ll gain insight into your circadian rhythm and energy levels, helping you plan for a productive day.

Sleeping refuels energy, and 83% of RISE users feel more energy in a week or less.

AUTOMATICALLY TRACK SLEEP
Through our integration with Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Oura, and data from other sleep trackers on your phone, like Sleep Cycle and ShutEye, RISE can determine the hours of sleep you get every night, sleep debt, the number of steps you take each day, as well as data from other activities that affect your sleep pattern.

WHY WE STARTED RISE
We want to help get ahead of the Insufficient Sleep Epidemic (CDC, 2014) we're experiencing, which has been increasing since 1985. This Epidemic has led to elevated mortality rates (Cappuccio, 2010) as well as underperformance in most aspects of life (RAND, 2016).

Today, we look at sleep as a luxury. RISE strives to create a world where healthy sleep is a necessity.

SleepSimple sleep tracker is suitable for anyone who:

SleepSimple sleep tracker keeps the process predictable so your sleep data stays meaningful over time.

No account. No sign-up. No email. No ads. Open it, allow Apple Health, and go to bed.

HOW IT WORKS
• Wear an Apple Watch to bed and open the app — sleep stages, heart rate, HRV, and breathing sync straight from Apple Health
• No watch? Set your iPhone on the mattress and tap Track Sleep with iPhone — it uses movement and sound to estimate your night
• Numbers match the Apple Health app exactly, down to the minute

WHAT YOU GET
• Sleep rings that show Sleep, Quality, and Deep at a glance
• Full stage breakdown — Deep, REM, Light, and Awake
• Bedtime, wake time, time to fall asleep, and sleep efficiency
• Readiness, Sleep Fuel, and Recovery scores built from your real HRV
• Heart rate, HRV, SpO2, and respiratory rate with Apple Watch
• A smart alarm that wakes you in a lighter stage near your target time
• Sleep consistency, trends, history, and a calendar of every night
• Tags for caffeine, late meals, workouts, and stress, so you can see what actually changes your sleep

BUILT BY ONE PERSON
I built SleepTracker for myself, in a year when AI finally made something like this achievable alone — then kept building whatever people asked for. No team, no investors, and no roadmap written by anyone but the people using it. And no subscription: sleep data you already own shouldn't be rented back to you month after month.

YOUR SLEEP DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
Sleep and health data is read from Apple Health only after you allow it. Microphone audio is analyzed on your device and is never recorded, stored, or uploaded. There is no account to create and no profile to sell. No tracking of you across other companies' apps or websites, and nothing shared with data brokers.

TELL ME WHAT TO BUILD
See something in another sleep app that you wish this one had? Email mark@vibecode.review. I read every message and I build what people actually ask for — that is how most of this app got here.

Sleep better by understanding your nights, automatically.

TRACK WITH YOUR IPHONE OR APPLE WATCH
Use Mattress or Nightstand mode to estimate your sleep stages without an Apple Watch. When Apple Watch stages are available, they take priority. WAKE YOUR WAY

Optional iOS system intervention is scheduled after the expected ring time plus Alarm Timeout and your chosen Intervention Delay, including after snooze. System Alarms permission is required for that fallback. App sounds and challenges depend on the app running; the system Stop button can dismiss its alarm without completing a challenge. Optional Shortcuts automation helps restore an active alarm when the app closes.

UNDERSTAND YOUR NIGHTS
Review sleep duration, Sleep Health, morning check-ins and trends. Scores with missing morning answers are marked provisional. Explore snoring estimates, short sound recordings and acoustic screening information. Recordings are samples, not a recording of the entire night, and are scheduled for deletion after one week.

UNWIND WITH LULLABIES
Choose relaxing sounds, mix your favorites and explore the full collection of 75 lullabies with Premium. Premium also offers binaural beats and saved blends.

MEET NANA
Get general sleep guidance in the free tier. Premium Nana can use your Me profile, tracked sleep, goals and saved context to personalize advice. Nana processes conversations on your device. CHOOSE YOUR LANGUAGE
Use English, French, Spanish, German, Simplified Chinese or Russian. The app follows supported system languages automatically, with English as the fallback. Change your preference in Settings. Nana text chat follows your chosen language; live neural voice conversations remain in English.

MAKE IT YOURS
Use light, dark or system appearance. Purple is included; Premium unlocks more accent colors and lets you customize tab order and dashboard layout.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Basic tracking, alarms, the nightly sleep goal, Overall stats, Duration trends, provided shortcuts, selected lullabies and data export are free. Eligible users can activate a 7-day Trial through Apple. It does not charge automatically. A separate one-time purchase unlocks Premium permanently, with no subscription renewal. The app shows the localized price before purchase.

YOUR DATA AND YOUR CHOICES
No app account is required. Sleep history, recordings and Nana conversations are processed locally. Apple Health sharing, purchases and limited trial-state sync follow your Apple settings. Feedback and bug reports are sent to us only when you choose Send. A filtered diagnostic attachment is optional and off by default.

Requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later. Sleep stages, scores, snoring and acoustic screening are wellness estimates, not medical measurements or diagnoses. Nana can make mistakes and does not replace professional care.

Track Mind, Body & Heart

Get the most out of your Apple Watch and Apple Health data to stay on top of your mental and physical health. Bvoy's holistic health reporting covers the 3 crucial aspects of fitness and wellness.

Mind

Resting Heart Rate - Resting heart rate (RHR) is a crucial indicator of overall health and plays a significant role in assessing heart function and cardiovascular well-being. Monitoring your RHR can provide valuable insights into your heart's health and your overall fitness level. 

Minimum Heart Rate - Monitoring your minimum heart rate throughout the day is crucial for assessing your cardiovascular health. This data provides valuable insights into your body's recovery, indicating how well your heart is resting during periods of inactivity. 

Deep Sleep hours - Deep sleep is a critical phase of the sleep cycle that plays a fundamental role in maintaining overall health and well-being. During deep sleep, the body undergoes essential restorative processes, including tissue repair, muscle growth, and hormone regulation. 

Heart

Heart Rate - Measuring heart rate is a simple yet powerful tool for understanding cardiovascular health. It provides essential data on how efficiently the heart is functioning, helping identify potential issues early on. 
Heart Rate Variability - Heart rate variability is a key indicator of overall health and resilience. It measures the variations in time between heartbeats, reflecting the balance of the autonomic nervous system. 

Body

Active Energy - Tracking active energy calories burned each day is vital for managing fitness goals and maintaining a healthy lifestyle. It represents the energy expended through physical activities and exercise, providing valuable insights into overall energy balance. 

Resting Energy or Basal Metabolic Energy - Resting energy calories burned daily reflect the energy the body expends to maintain basic physiological functions during rest. 
Exercise Minutes - reports the time spent exercising every day.

results.description:
Sleep tracking and a smart alarm, using the phone you already own.
No watch. No band. Nothing extra to wear or charge.

Every morning: a sleep score that shows its working, and one change worth making tonight.

A SMART ALARM YOU CANNOT SLEEP THROUGH

Set the latest time you want to be up. For the final 30 minutes Sleepfy watches for movement and, when you are already stirring, eases you awake with sound and gentle vibration rather than a jolt.

The alarm is scheduled through iOS. It rings on time, at full volume, even on Silent or in a Focus mode. The gentle part is a bonus. The time is guaranteed.

A SCORE THAT EXPLAINS ITSELF

Trackers hand you a number. Sleepfy shows the working.

Open any night to see how it was reached: sleep against your goal, how late you turned in, and schedule consistency. Each explains what it cost or earned, so the number is something you can act on.

ADVICE FROM YOUR OWN NIGHTS

Not the same twelve sleep tips every app gives you. Sleepfy reads your history: which habits track with better nights, and where your schedule is slipping.

NINETY NIGHTS ON ONE SCREEN

Your last 90 nights, one square each, coloured by how long you slept against your own goal. Tap any night for its date and duration. Week-over-week change on your score and bedtime consistency, so the numbers show a direction, not just a value.

HEAR WHAT WAS IN THE ROOM

Snoring, talking, coughing, a door, a dog outside. Sleepfy picks them out and lays them on a timeline beside your stages, timed to the minute.

Play them back. A snoring report you can listen to is one you can check, not take on trust.

SEE THE SHAPE OF YOUR NIGHT

Deep, light, REM and awake time, with a graph of how the night unfolded. These are estimates from duration, bedtime and how settled the night was, and Sleepfy says so.

Deep sleep is judged against what is typical for your age, since it falls as you get older, not one fixed range for everyone.

HOW IT WORKS

Open Track before bed, start a session, and put your phone face-down on the mattress near your pillow, plugged in. Sleepfy reads the room and your motion sensors overnight. A few short clips from the most recent night are kept so you can hear what it heard — the next night replaces them, and you can switch this off. Stop the session in the morning and your report is ready.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

No accounts, no servers. Your sleep data lives on your device and in your private iCloud, encrypted and tied to your Apple ID. We cannot read it. Nothing is sold, there are no ads, and you can clear it all in-app anytime.

EVERYTHING ELSE

• Journal — log caffeine, alcohol, exercise, stress and screen time, and see how they line up with your sleep
• Five home-screen widget styles — check last night without opening the app
• Streaks for a steady schedule, with a goal you can change anytime
• Private iCloud sync — your history survives a new iPhone and a reinstall

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH

Sleepfy reads from and writes to Apple Health. If you own an Apple Watch, Sleepfy uses its measured sleep stages instead of estimates.

SLEEPFY PREMIUM

Sleepfy is free to download. Full access requires a subscription:

• Annual — includes a 7-day free trial
• Monthly — no trial

Prices vary by region and are shown before confirmation. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase. Subscriptions renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in iPhone Settings. Any unused trial portion is forfeited when you subscribe.

Sleepfy is a wellness app, not a medical device, and does not diagnose, treat or prevent conditions. For health concerns, speak to a doctor.

Track your sleep stages, snoring, sleep talking, and nighttime breathing in one place. No subscription. No accounts. No servers. No ads.

Wear your Apple Watch for sleep stages, heart rate, HRV, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, and wrist temperature. Add your iPhone for snore detection, sleep talking detection, breathing pause detection, and a full audio timeline of the night. Use both for the complete picture.

Everything stays on your device. Audio never leaves your phone.

Press record before bed. Wake up to your sleep score, stage breakdown, and every notable sound from the night. Playable, taggable, exportable.

KEY FEATURES

- Apple Watch Companion
   See last night's summary, browse past nights, and view live biometrics during a recording. Stop a recording from your wrist.

- Sleep Stages from Apple Watch & Wearables
   Pull sleep stages, heart rate, HRV, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, and wrist temperature straight from your watch or any wearable that syncs to Apple Health.

- Audio Sleep Stage Estimation
   Sleep stage classification from audio alone. Breathing regularity, breathing rate, movement, and snoring patterns combine to estimate Light, Deep, REM, and Awake.

- Hypnogram Source Picker
   Switch the nightly sleep stage chart between audio analysis and Apple Watch data. Compare both views of the same night.

- Sleep Score Watch Complication
   Add the Snore Timeline complication to any watch face for last night's sleep score at a glance.

- Snore Detection
   Every snore captured with volume, duration, and frequency. Tap any snore to play it back.

- Snore Nudge
   When sustained snoring is detected, your Apple Watch taps your wrist so you shift position, without waking you. Every nudge is saved to the nightly summary with how your snoring responded in the minutes around it. Requires a paired Apple Watch.

- Snores Per Minute
   See your snore rate charted across the whole night against your personal baseline, with a breakdown of how snoring built up and settled around each time you woke.

- Visual Snore Timeline
   See your entire night at a glance. Enable Loud Sound Detection for frequency-based coloring showing low, mid, and high frequencies.

- AirPods & Bluetooth Recording
   Record through AirPods or a Bluetooth headset instead of the phone mic, with automatic level calibration for consistent volume.

- Sleep Talking Detection
   Speech recognized as sleep talking and displayed on your timeline with playable clips.

- Breathing Pause Detection
   Flags 10+ second silence followed by a recovery breath, a pattern that may explain poor sleep quality.

- Sleep Score & Insights
   A nightly score based on duration, stage balance, efficiency, time to fall asleep, awakenings, and snoring.

- Sleep Factors
   Tag what shaped your night, like caffeine, alcohol, or a late meal, and see which factors line up with better or worse sleep over time.

- Sleep Schedule & Wake-Up Alarm
   Set a bedtime reminder and a wake-up time. Recording stops at your wake-up time with an optional alarm sound.

- Smart Wake Up Alarm
   Wake during a light-sleep moment in a window before your set time, so you start the day less groggy. The alarm fades in from quiet, and still rings at your set time if a light-sleep window never comes.

- Wake by Wrist Tap
   Wake to silent taps on your Apple Watch instead of a sound, so you can get up without disturbing a partner. Requires a paired Apple Watch.

- Loud Sound Detection
   Capture any sound above a volume threshold. Useful for alarms, pets, or mumbling.

- Weekly Trends
   Track progress week over week with charts comparing duration, scores, and efficiency.

- Custom Range Export
   Pick a date range and choose what to include: nightly summaries, stages, episodes, biometrics, and audio. Generate CSV reports for sleep specialists.

- Completely Private
   Everything on your device. No account required. Audio never leaves your phone.

Link your Apple Watch, Oura, Fitbit, or any device that syncs with Apple Health or Google Health Connect, and your Sleep Diary fills in automatically each morning. Every entry can be reviewed and edited, and you answer only the questions your device can't track. The manual diary is unchanged for members without a wearable.

Also in this release: trend views in the Sleep Diary tab for sleep efficiency and total sleep time.

Bug fixes and performance improvements.
results.description:
Whether you struggle to fall asleep, wake up during the night, or never feel rested, Sleepio is a self-paced sleep improvement program proven to help you sleep better. Unlike mindfulness and meditation apps, Sleepio helps you address the root causes of poor sleep resulting in long-lasting improvements.

KEY FEATURES:
– A structured, self-paced program of clinically proven cognitive and behavioral techniques, designed to help you sleep better, reframe unhelpful thoughts, and learn healthy habits.

– A Sleep Diary to gain insights, see your progress, and tailor your program, with trend views for sleep efficiency and total sleep time

– Automatic Sleep Diary logging from your wearable. Connect your Apple Watch, Oura, Fitbit, or any device that syncs with Apple Health or Google Health Connect. Review or edit any entry, and answer only what your device can't track.

– An on-demand daytime toolkit to set yourself up for successful sleep and a nighttime toolkit for in-the-moment help with getting to sleep.

– Progress Review to track how your sleep is improving over time. Sleepio may be available at no cost through your employer benefits. Check your coverage at sleepio.bighealth.com

Questions? Reach out to us at hello@sleepio.com

Disclaimer: Sleepio is a digital program that may help individuals live well with insomnia disorder and poor sleep by providing them with cognitive and behavioral techniques that can improve sleep. Sleepio has not been reviewed or approved by the Food & Drug Administration and is not intended to diagnose or treat any medical condition. Please read the instructions for use.

results.description:
Life as a new parent can be demanding, and you need all the help you can get to focus on what really matters; enjoy the precious time with your baby.

Do you often ask yourself the following questions?
• Which side did baby feed on last?
• What did my partner give my baby for lunch?
• How much did baby eat compared to previous weeks?
• How long was the midday nap?
• What time did the little one wake up?
• Who changed diaper for baby?
• What was the last weigh-in?

Keep track of all the details for your baby’s activities either logged by you, your partner, grandparents, nannies, or friends. Get 100% real-time synchronization and immediate feedback through notifications when activities are logged.

Breastfeed, pumping, bottle, solids, sleep, diaper tracking, training and developing routines for one or multiple babies. Mjello Baby helps you to keep full track of your baby’s development.

KEY FEATURES
• Invite unlimited number of caregivers
You need all the help you can get! We know that taking care of a baby can be stressful. That’s why you can invite all the caregivers you like with instant access. Revoking access from a caregiver is also as easy as inviting. You have full control.

• Log unlimited number of activities and real-time synchronization
Whether you or one of your caregivers logged an activity – the information will be synchronized immediately between your devices. Notifications will notify you as soon as an activity is logged by other caregivers.

All activities allow to add notes for extra details.

• Feed Tracking
Choose how you will feed your baby (breast vs bottle). Track how long your nursing sessions are and the time between the feeds. Perfect for both feeding on demand and schedules. Once baby grows record solids and details of what type of food was eaten.

• Pump Tracking
Keep a log of how much you breast pump and which side was most recently used.

• Sleep Tracking
Record your baby's day time and night time sleeping patterns. Ideal for establishing and sticking to your baby’s sleeping routines.

• Diaper Tracking
Record your baby's wet or dirty diapers and even the size. Add notes when your baby uses a diaper or a potty once you start toilet-training. 

• Baby Growth Tracking
Monitor your baby’s growth by tracking height, weight gains and head size on charts developed by World Health Organization (WHO) Child Growth Standards.

• Daily Activity Timeline
What has your baby been up to today? And what about yesterday? Get a map out of your baby’s routine in a calendar.

• Detailed stats and graphs
The stats in each section will help paint the full picture of your baby’s development. Track the weekly progression of all activities enabling you to compare averages and trends (up- and downtrends).

Are you ready to become super charged? Download now and focus on what really matters!

MJELLO BABY PREMIUM
• View activities beyond 72 hours
• Get statistics and analytics insights
• Access baby growth plan
• Add and track unlimited no. of babies
• Securely backup data in the cloud by creating an account, and much more!

Mjello Baby offers auto-renewing subscription:

The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal at the total subscription price within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions and auto-renewals may be managed or canceled via your iTunes Account settings. Any unused portion of free trial is forfeited after purchase.
